args.body: Take SHOPIFY-BROWSER-DELIVERY-TEST as a bounded delivery experiment. Reuse existing semantics and fixtures; do not grow catalogue functionality or publish. Check installed browser execution capability before implementation, and stop if meaningful execution/parity evidence cannot be produced. The reason for narrowly revisiting the building stop rule is the existing Python prerequisite, not new buyer demand. Preserve CSV 19 Nov 01:30:37 UTC, Shopify 19 Nov 21:30:49 UTC, welfare 20 Nov observation windows and welfare retirement after 4 Dec 17:00 UTC. Collection remains unavailable; unclassified feedback remains unknown.

description: Feedback is available but has no classified commercial events and three unclassified sources; demand remains unknown. The Shopify example currently requires Python. Test whether its existing transformation can be delivered locally in a browser, reducing a concrete usage prerequisite. This is a delivery experiment, not evidence of buyers or revenue. Funding remains unverified and unavailable; existing observation windows stay open.
